name: Text animation showcase — shared-slide-opacity-stage
description: Showcases the shared-slide-opacity-stage renderer family (ADR-0011, short-slide-right catalog effect). The title 'Think different' slides once as a whole while individual words fade opacity in a stagger. Title-only — the title-level transform is shared by every word, so the renderer assumes single-line phrase content. Channel chrome notes: chrome-light verification preset; channel-specific text moves would be a follow-up Brief.

content.title: Think different
content.body: The phrase slides as one transform while each word's opacity staggers behind.
